lessons.title: Takeoff Basics
lessons.description: Learn how throttle, airspeed and lift work together during the first seconds of flight.

steps.title: Power up
steps.instruction: Increase throttle above 70%. Watch the thrust bar and airspeed indicator.
steps.successMessage: Great. The aircraft is producing enough thrust to accelerate.

steps.title: Build airspeed
steps.instruction: Keep the aircraft level until airspeed passes 65 knots.
steps.successMessage: Nice. More speed means more airflow over the wing.

steps.title: Rotate gently
steps.instruction: Pitch up gently and let the aircraft climb. Avoid over-rotating.
steps.successMessage: Smooth rotation. The aircraft is entering a controlled climb.

steps.title: Positive climb
steps.instruction: Climb above 300 feet while keeping airspeed stable.
steps.successMessage: Takeoff complete. You established a stable climb.

lessons.title: Straight and Level Flight
lessons.description: Practice balancing lift, weight, thrust and drag during stable cruise.

steps.title: Level the nose
steps.instruction: Keep pitch close to zero and reduce vertical speed.
steps.successMessage: Good. The aircraft is nearly level.

steps.title: Cruise throttle
steps.instruction: Set throttle between 45% and 65% for efficient cruise.
